targets.rawSql: SELECT NOW() as time, SUM(total_amount) as value FROM ecommerce_events WHERE ingested_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '1 hour' AND status='completed'
SELECT NOW() as time, COUNT(*) as value FROM ecommerce_events WHERE ingested_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '1 hour'
SELECT NOW() as time, AVG(total_amount) as value FROM ecommerce_events WHERE ingested_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '1 hour' AND status='completed'
SELECT NOW() as time, SUM(CASE WHEN status='completed' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0 END)/NULLIF(COUNT(*),0) as value FROM ecommerce_events WHERE ingested_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '1 hour'
SELECT date_trunc('minute', ingested_at) AS time, SUM(total_amount) AS "Chiffre d'Affaires" FROM ecommerce_events WHERE $__timeFilter(ingested_at) AND status='completed' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT category AS metric, SUM(total_amount) AS value FROM ecommerce_events WHERE ingested_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '2 hours' AND status='completed' GROUP BY category ORDER BY value DESC
SELECT device AS metric, COUNT(*) AS value FROM ecommerce_events WHERE ingested_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '1 hour' GROUP BY device ORDER BY value DESC

SELECT ingested_at AS "Heure", city AS "Ville", category AS "Catégorie", product_name AS "Produit", total_amount AS "Montant (€)", status AS "Statut", payment_method AS "Paiement" FROM ecommerce_events ORDER BY ingested_at DESC LIMIT 20
